idea-plugin.name: Agent Watch
idea-plugin.description:
Companion to Agent Watch, a macOS app that shows what your Claude Code and Codex sessions are doing. On its own this plugin does nothing.

It covers sessions started in the IDE's terminal. When you jump to such a session from Agent Watch, the plugin selects the terminal tab where it is running, in both the classic and the reworked terminal, instead of leaving you at the IDE window. The app reaches the plugin through a jetbrains:// link that names the agent's process.

No network, no ports. The plugin writes one small file into Agent Watch's own folder so the app can confirm the plugin is installed: the token it was asked with, the plugin version, the IDE build and when it answered.

Get Agent Watch: github.com/glockbender/agentwatcher
idea-plugin.change-notes: First version on JetBrains Marketplace. Finds the tab in both the classic and the reworked terminal, and answers the widget's installation check.
